frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: Traveller, your groove is extraordinary. You have our trust. Let us move forward...

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: Traveller, behold Melodious Crest, the dwelling of the Elder Maoi, guardian of the Celestial Amp.

frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: Elder Maoi, we bring before you a traveller of remarkable groove, seeking to restore the lost harmony of Harmonius.

frames.heading: Elder Maoi
frames.body: Greetings, traveller. Your arrival stirs hope within me, yet I am burdened by doubt. The Grand Composer's silence has weighed heavily upon our world, and I fear the repercussions of wielding such power.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Elder Maoi, I understand your apprehension. But the silence cannot persist. Harmonius must reclaim its melody, and I am here to ensure that.

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: The traveller's groove has already resonated with the very essence of Harmonius. He is the one destined to wield the Celestial Amp.

frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: Please, Elder Maoi, trust in his ability to restore the harmony we've lost.

frames.heading: Elder Maoi
frames.body: Very well. Traveller, the Celestial Amp is a tool of great power. Use it wisely and with reverence for the harmony of Harmonius.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thank you, Elder Maoi. I accept this responsibility with humility and determination.

frames.heading: Monad
frames.body: The time has come, traveller. With the Celestial Amp in your hands, you possess the means to confront the Grand Composer and bring back the symphony of Harmonius.

frames.heading: Funktor
frames.body: We place our faith in you. Go forth and reclaim the melody that binds us all.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Grand Composer, your reign of silence ends now. With the Celestial Amp, I shall restore the harmony of Harmonius, and your tyranny shall crumble before the might of GROOVE!!!!!!
